readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: a '+' and the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in canonical E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A stable customer code assigned on create, formatted
                '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first
                three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased first three
                letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners already in
                that city at the time of creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household. Owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set true that
                match an existing owner's lastName and address are assigned the
                same householdId as that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key, formed as the normalized
                telephone, the email (or an empty string when absent) and the
                householdId joined by '|'. This single key is the sole basis for
                duplicate detection on create: a new owner is rejected with 409
                only when its whole identityKey equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3F2A1B9C7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners at the time of creation that share
                this owner's firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively
                (not counting this owner). Assigned on create.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A stable membership number assigned on create, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal
                year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the
                calendar year in which it ends. Absent when no registrationDate
                has been assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on create: starting at
                0, plus 2 when an email address is present, plus 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members,
                plus 3 when the owner's tenure is more than one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points and level 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent
                when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known
                region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO

## What I found

The repo's **only** test is `AcceptanceTest`, and it's the *acceptance test for the upcoming change itself* — it asserts a `memberId` field exists and that `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are gone. It is red now and can only go green by implementing the change, which I was told **not** to do. So there were no currently-green tests to protect beyond compilation + behavior; the acceptance test remains red for exactly its pre-existing reason (`memberId` null at line 16), not any new one I introduced.

The codebase already models the intended prep pattern in `OwnerAuditor` — a small, documented **seam** (`primaryIdentifier`) that localizes where the customerCode→memberId unification lands. I mirrored that ethos rather than speculatively building the new format (which needs the `Owner.memberId` field, DTO, and `openapi.yml` — i.e. the change).

## Changes made (all behavior-preserving)

1. **`OwnerMapper.luhn` → `public static`** — the future `OwnerRegistrar.memberId` lives in a different package and must compute the CHK through the one Luhn implementation, exactly as it already reaches the `public static` `fiscalYear`/`identityKey`. It was package-private, so `memberId` couldn't reach it without duplicating the algorithm. Javadoc notes it's the single Luhn derivation, exposed like its siblings.

2. **`OwnerMapper.locality`** — extracted the "read the REGION back out of the stored identity code" logic into a private `identityRegion(owner)` helper. This becomes the single swap point for the future `memberIdSegments(...).region()`, and keeps `locality` down to "identity region, else resolver fallback."

3. **`OwnerRegistrar.customerCode`** — extracted the collision de-duplication loop into a `disambiguate(base, existing)` helper. The change applies collision handling to the memberId; it can now reuse this one de-dup step instead of re-growing it inside the new `memberId` builder.

I deliberately did **not** touch `OwnerMapper.fiscalYear` (rerouting it to parse an identifier would break owners that have a registration date but no assigned code — a real behavior change the change spec owns), did not alter `OwnerAuditor` (already seamed for the structured event), and did not add `Owner.getMemberId/setMemberId` (that field is the change).
